_how_to_add_a_book: Copy one entry, change the fields, and upload the PDF to public/library/books/. Use "file" for a PDF kept on this site, or "box" for a Box share link. "rights" is required: say why the school may publish the book. Full steps: docs/library.md

books.title: The Brave Tin Soldier
books.author: Hans Christian Andersen
books.about: A one-legged tin soldier loves a paper dancer, sails down a rainy street in a paper boat, survives inside a big fish, and finds his way back home. Classic reader companion workbook with story, vocabulary, comprehension, and book report activities.
books.rights: Classroom reader workbook (Young Learners Classic Readers 1-3, Compass Publishing) for Creative Minds Kid 1 students.

books.title: Hansel and Gretel
books.author: Brothers Grimm
books.about: Clever Hansel and brave Gretel leave a trail of white rocks, discover a candy house deep in the forest, and outsmart a wicked witch to get back to their father. Classic reader companion workbook with word search, comprehension, and book report activities.
books.rights: Classroom reader workbook (Young Learners Classic Readers 1-2, Compass Publishing) for Creative Minds Kid 2 students.

books.title: Jack and the Magic Beans
books.author: Joseph Jacobs
books.about: Jack trades his cow for five magic beans, climbs a towering beanstalk into the clouds, outwits a hungry giant, and brings home gold, a goose, and a magic harp. Classic reader companion workbook with crossword, comprehension, and book report activities.
books.rights: Classroom reader workbook (Young Learners Classic Readers 2-5, Compass Publishing) for Creative Minds Kid 3 students.

books.title: The Trojan Horse
books.author: Virgil
books.about: After ten years outside Troy's strong walls, the Greeks build a giant wooden horse to trick the Trojans and win back Helen, while Aeneas escapes with his father and son. Classic reader companion workbook with crossword, comprehension, and book report activities.
books.rights: Classroom reader workbook (Young Learners Classic Readers 2-10, Compass Publishing) for Creative Minds Kid 4 students.

books.title: Daedalus and Icarus
books.author: Ovid
books.about: Trapped on the island of Crete after building the Minotaur's labyrinth, clever inventor Daedalus crafts wings of feathers, string, and wax for himself and his son Icarus—with one crucial warning. Classic reader companion workbook with word search, comprehension, and book report activities.
books.rights: Classroom reader workbook (Young Learners Classic Readers 3-4, Compass Publishing) for Creative Minds Kid 5 students.

books.title: Heidi
books.author: Johanna Spyri
books.about: Young orphan Heidi grows up happily in the Swiss Alps with her grandfather, Peter, and two mountain goats, befriends Klara in the city, and helps her walk again in the fresh mountain air. Classic reader companion workbook with word search, comprehension, and book report activities.
books.rights: Classroom reader workbook (Young Learners Classic Readers 3-7, Compass Publishing) for Creative Minds Kid 6 students.

books.title: Gulliver's Travels
books.author: Jonathan Swift
books.about: Shipwrecked doctor Lemuel Gulliver swims ashore to Lilliput, meets people only six inches tall, captures Blefuscu's fleet, and repairs a boat to sail home with tiny cows and sheep in his pockets. Classic reader companion workbook with crossword, word-part unscramble, comprehension, and book report activities.
books.rights: Classroom reader workbook (Young Learners Classic Readers 4-4, Compass Publishing) for Creative Minds Kid 7 students.

books.title: Beauty and the Beast
books.author: Jeanne-Marie Leprince de Beaumont
books.about: When a lost merchant picks a single rose from an enchanted palace garden, his kind youngest daughter Beauty bravely takes his place, discovers the goodness inside the Beast, and breaks a wicked fairy's spell. Classic reader companion workbook with crossword, cause-and-consequence chart, comprehension, and book report activities.
books.rights: Classroom reader workbook (Young Learners Classic Readers 4-2, Compass Publishing) for Creative Minds Kid 8 students.

books.title: The Gift of the Magi
books.author: O. Henry
books.about: With only $1.87 left on Christmas Eve, Della sells her lovely long hair to buy a platinum chain for Jim's watch—while Jim sells his watch to buy expensive combs for Della's hair. Classic reader companion workbook with crossword, sentence unscrambles, comprehension, and book report activities.
books.rights: Classroom reader workbook (Young Learners Classic Readers 5-10, Compass Publishing) for Creative Minds Kid 9 students.

books.title: The Last Lesson
books.author: Alphonse Daudet
books.about: Hurrying late to school in Alsace, young Franz learns that Mr. Hamel is teaching his final French lesson before German replaces it—and the whole village gathers in silent respect to treasure their language. Classic reader companion workbook with Venn diagram, sentence editing, comprehension, and book report activities.
books.rights: Classroom reader workbook (Young Learners Classic Readers 5-2, Compass Publishing) for Creative Minds Kid 10 students.

books.title: The Count of Monte Cristo
books.author: Alexandre Dumas
books.about: Falsely arrested at his wedding and locked inside Château d'If, sailor Edmond Dantes meets old Faria, escapes into the sea, uncovers the treasure of Monte Cristo, and ultimately chooses wisdom over revenge. Classic reader companion workbook with Venn diagram, sentence editing, comprehension, and book report activities.
books.rights: Classroom reader workbook (Young Learners Classic Readers 6-10, Compass Publishing) for Creative Minds Kid 11 students.

books.title: Tales from the Arabian Nights
books.author: Edited by David Foulds
books.about: Every night clever Sheherezade saves her life by telling King Shahriah an unfinished tale—the fisherman and the genie in the bottle, Aladdin and his magic lamp, Ali Baba and Morgiana, Sinbad the Sailor, and Sidi Ahmad. Full-colour 1,400-headword graded reader with all seven chapter activities and a book report.
books.rights: Classroom graded reader (Oxford Progressive English Readers Grade 1, Oxford University Press) for Creative Minds students.

books.title: Alice's Adventures in Wonderland
books.author: Lewis Carroll
books.about: Alice follows a white rabbit down a hole and finds a world where nothing behaves as it should. The complete 1865 text in twelve chapters.
books.rights: Public domain. Text from Standard Ebooks (CC0).
